# Probability Distributions

Distributions are mathematical descriptions of how phenomena behave. This section covers the most common probability distributions, organized by type.

## Discrete Distributions

Discrete distributions describe data that falls within distinct categories (typically integer values).

:::{.callout-note}
**Finite support** distributions have a finite number of possible outcomes.
**Infinite support** distributions have an infinite (countable) number of possible outcomes.
:::

### With Finite Support

- [Bernoulli](discrete/bernoulli.qmd) - The most basic distribution for binary outcomes
- [Binomial](discrete/binomial.qmd) - Number of successes in N independent Bernoulli trials
- [Hypergeometric](discrete/hypergeometric.qmd) - Like binomial but without replacement
- [Beta-Binomial](discrete/beta_binomial.qmd) - Binomial with probability sampled from a Beta distribution
- [Poisson Binomial](discrete/poisson_binomial.qmd) - Binomial with different probabilities for each trial
- [Negative Binomial](discrete/negative_binomial.qmd) - Number of failures before r successes
- [Negative Hypergeometric](discrete/negative_hypergeometric.qmd) - Number drawn before k successes without replacement

### With Infinite Support

- [Poisson](discrete/poisson.qmd) - Events in a fixed time/space interval
- [Geometric](discrete/geometric.qmd) - Number of trials until first success
- [Beta Negative Binomial](discrete/beta_negative_binomial.qmd) - Negative binomial with Beta-distributed probability

## Continuous Distributions

Continuous distributions describe data that exists on a number line.

- [Normal](continuous/normal.qmd) - The bell curve, central to statistics
- [Beta](continuous/beta.qmd) - Distribution on [0,1] interval
- [Logistic Normal](continuous/logistic_normal.qmd) - Logit-transformed normal distribution
- [Chi](continuous/chi.qmd) - Distribution of square root of chi-squared
- [Chi-Squared](continuous/chi_squared.qmd) - Sum of squared standard normals
- [Exponential](continuous/exponential.qmd) - Time between events in Poisson process
- [F](continuous/f.qmd) - Ratio of chi-squared distributions
- [Student's T](continuous/student_t.qmd) - Estimating normal mean with unknown variance
- [Logistic](continuous/logistic.qmd) - Used in logistic regression
- [Gamma](continuous/gamma.qmd) - Generalization of exponential distribution
